entry.summary: A 90-day visitor permit on arrival for tourism, applied for on the passenger arrival card.
entry.pre_arrival: Confirmed return or onward ticket and enough funds.
entry.passport_validity: At least 6 months beyond the intended stay.
entry.other: Business visitor permits and other purposes go through Samoa Immigration, Ministry of the Prime Minister and Cabinet.

money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: ATMs at the airport and major centres. Cards at most resorts and large shops; few small businesses take them.

laws.rule: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, can bring jail. Owning drug-related equipment is illegal. Police may detain you while they investigate.
Legal drinking age 21. Alcohol can't be sold on Sundays.
Same-sex relationships aren't recognised and consensual sex between men is illegal. Avoid public affection.
Sunday activity is very limited; most businesses close, hotels and resorts run as normal. Prostitution is illegal.
Declare more than WST 20,000 (any form) on arrival and departure.
You need a temporary Samoan licence, from the Samoa Tourism Fale, the Land Transport Authority or some car hire agencies, on showing your Australian licence and paying a fee.

culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Each village sets its own rules: ask your host or the village before visiting.
